These compact evidence fixtures are projected from archived local responses.
They retain the questions and native event/frame fields needed by regression
tests, without model traces, timings, duplicate result trees, image bytes,
credentials, or live service dependencies. Absolute workspace prefixes are
replaced by `/recorded-workspace/`; observations and capture times are unchanged.

Tests resolve this directory relative to their source files. The original
`work` archives and uploaded videos are optional and are never loaded by these
unit regressions. Source and projection hashes for this migration are recorded
in `work/project_fixes_20261026/fixture_projection.json`.
